lead.purpose: planning and prioritization over sanitized context (Lead/primary, high thinking)

worker.purpose: tactical execution summaries; never raw credentials (Worker/subagent, default thinking)

cheap_fallback.purpose: fallback for both Lead and Worker on 429/5xx or capacity - switch --model to this and retry once with bounded backoff

trusted_sensitive.purpose: operator-approved provider/combo for sensitive but redacted evidence

operator_checks: Confirm the four connected connections are authorized for this use.
Inspect /v1/models and the auto-combo candidate list before a session.
Enable OmniRoute freeAccessPolicy=strict only after checking its live catalog and usage adapters.
Keep raw cookies, passwords, API keys, and unredacted PII on a local-only route.
Record route, provider, model, and data class in every result.
